description: The bar chart, titled "Model Evaluation on Academic and Public Benchmarks," compares the performance of two models—labeled "Ours (Iterative)" in orange and "Ours" in blue—across eight different datasets and metrics. The horizontal axis lists the datasets and metrics, including GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (×5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The vertical axis represents the score in percentage, ranging from 0 to 80. For each dataset, two bars are shown side-by-side, with the orange bar (Ours (Iterative)) generally being taller than the blue bar (Ours), indicating higher scores. The highest scores are observed on the MBPP and ARC datasets, where both models achieve scores above 80%. The lowest scores are on the LC AlpacaEval-2 dataset, where the blue model scores approximately 70% and the orange model scores around 80%. The chart visually demonstrates that the "Ours (Iterative)" model consistently outperforms the "Ours" model across all evaluated benchmarks.
